title: The Ass and the Wolf
summary: An ass grazing in a meadow saw a ravenous wolf approaching with bared fangs. Through unexpected trial and turning point, each character learns that sharp presence of mind in danger turns an enemy’s weapons into his own downfall.
full_text: An ass grazing in a meadow saw a ravenous wolf approaching with bared fangs. Knowing he had no speed to outrun the beast, the ass immediately began limping with dramatic groans, dragging his hind leg through the clover. The curious wolf paused and asked: "Why do you limp so pitifully, beast?" "Alas, sir," wept the ass, "while leaping a hedge, a giant, jagged thorn pierced the sole of my hoof! I know you are going to eat me, but I beg you: pull out the thorn first, lest it pierce your throat and choke you while you feast upon my flank!" The wolf thought this prudent advice. He stepped behind the ass, lifted the hoof, and bent his eyes close to search for the thorn. In that instant, the ass kicked out with both hind hooves with thunderous force! The iron-hard hooves struck the wolf squarely in the mouth, shattering his teeth and splitting his jaw, while the ass galloped off to safety, laughing at the fallen predator.
moral: Sharp presence of mind in danger turns an enemy’s weapons into his own downfall.
